title: 情感丰富的文字
summary: 字符串 s 可把原词中某个连续字母组扩展到至少三个相同字母，统计 words 中能扩展成 s 的单词数。
insight: 同步按字符组比较：字符必须相同，原组不能更长；若组长不同，目标组长度必须至少为三。
pitfalls: 长度为二的目标组不能由更短组扩展
原组与目标组长度相同始终合法
两字符串都必须恰好遍历完

solutions.title: 双指针比较连续字符组
solutions.idea: 逐组验证字符、长度和可拉伸条件。
steps: i、j 指向 s 与 word 当前组首字符，字符不同失败
分别找到组尾并计算 targetCount、wordCount
若 wordCount>targetCount，或两者不同且 targetCount<3 则失败；推进到下一组，最后要求同时结束

code.java: class Solution { public int expressiveWords(String s,String[] words){int answer=0;for(String word:words)if(stretchy(s,word))answer++;return answer;}private boolean stretchy(String target,String word){int i=0,j=0;while(i<target.length()&&j<word.length()){if(target.charAt(i)!=word.charAt(j))return false;int nextI=i+1,nextJ=j+1;while(nextI<target.length()&&target.charAt(nextI)==target.charAt(i))nextI++;while(nextJ<word.length()&&word.charAt(nextJ)==word.charAt(j))nextJ++;int a=nextI-i,b=nextJ-j;if(b>a||a!=b&&a<3)return false;i=nextI;j=nextJ;}return i==target.length()&&j==word.length();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun expressiveWords(s:String,words:Array<String>):Int=words.count{stretchy(s,it)};private fun stretchy(target:String,word:String):Boolean{var i=0;var j=0;while(i<target.length&&j<word.length){if(target[i]!=word[j])return false;var nextI=i+1;var nextJ=j+1;while(nextI<target.length&&target[nextI]==target[i])nextI++;while(nextJ<word.length&&word[nextJ]==word[j])nextJ++;val a=nextI-i;val b=nextJ-j;if(b>a||a!=b&&a<3)return false;i=nextI;j=nextJ};return i==target.length&&j==word.length} }
code.cpp: class Solution { bool stretchy(string& target,string& word){int i=0,j=0;while(i<(int)target.size()&&j<(int)word.size()){if(target[i]!=word[j])return false;int nextI=i+1,nextJ=j+1;while(nextI<(int)target.size()&&target[nextI]==target[i])++nextI;while(nextJ<(int)word.size()&&word[nextJ]==word[j])++nextJ;int a=nextI-i,b=nextJ-j;if(b>a||(a!=b&&a<3))return false;i=nextI;j=nextJ;}return i==(int)target.size()&&j==(int)word.size();}public:int expressiveWords(string s,vector<string>& words){int answer=0;for(string& word:words)answer+=stretchy(s,word);return answer;} };
